**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/22 (Mon) 19:36
- [USER] User requested a summary of a specific section of text.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Section 7 outlines the process for a joint resolution of disapproval of designation or removal of designation of a foreign adversary.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] If the Secretary of Commerce designates or removes the designation of a foreign government or regime as a foreign adversary, a joint resolution of disapproval may be introduced within 60 days, which is entitled to expedited consideration.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The section outlines the procedures for introducing and considering the joint resolution in the House of Representatives and the Senate.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The section specifies the effect of such joint resolutions of disapproval of designation or removal of designation.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] This section is enacted as an exercise of the rulemaking power of the Senate and House of Representatives, respectively.
